description: We are enthusiastic students passionate about technology, innovation, and space exploration. Our project, ASTROCARE, aims to develop intelligent health monitoring software for astronauts, tracking vital signs and detecting potential health risks during space missions. We welcome passionate team members interested in Python, AI/ML, data analysis, UI/UX design, healthcare technology, and space science. Beginners and creative thinkers are welcome. Let's collaborate and make space missions safer!
summary:
ASTROCARE is an intelligent astronaut health monitoring software designed to support astronauts' health and safety during space missions. The system aims to continuously monitor important health parameters such as heart rate, oxygen saturation, body temperature, respiratory rate, stress, and hydration levels through a user-friendly dashboard.

It identifies unusual changes in health data, provides real-time alerts, and helps detect potential health risks at an early stage. It also aims to support remote health monitoring by allowing medical teams to observe astronauts' health conditions and provide timely assistance.

Space environments can significantly affect the human body, making continuous health monitoring essential. ASTROCARE addresses this challenge by combining technology, health data analysis, and intelligent monitoring to improve astronaut safety, support better medical decisions, and contribute to safer and more successful space missions.

**ASTROCARE – Healthy Astronauts, Safer Space Missions!**
details:
ASTROCARE – Intelligent Astronaut Health Monitoring System

ASTROCARE is a proposed intelligent health monitoring system designed to support astronaut health and safety during space missions. Space environments can affect the human body in several ways, including changes in heart rate, oxygen levels, body temperature, sleep patterns, stress, and hydration. ASTROCARE aims to help monitor these important health indicators through a simple and user-friendly digital dashboard.

The system works by displaying astronaut health parameters and analysing the available readings to identify unusual changes. When a value moves beyond a defined safe range, the system can generate an alert to indicate a possible health concern. This information can help astronauts and medical support teams recognise potential risks earlier and make timely decisions.

The main benefit of ASTROCARE is that it supports continuous health observation and makes important health information easier to understand. Its intended impact is to improve astronaut safety, support early identification of possible health problems, and contribute to safer and more successful space missions.

For the concept prototype, we use Python for data handling and analysis, along with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for a user-friendly dashboard. Sample or simulated health data can be used to demonstrate the monitoring and alert system. The concept can be extended in the future to connect with wearable sensors and real-time health monitoring devices.

ASTROCARE is creative because it brings health monitoring, data analysis, visualisation, and alert generation together in one astronaut-focused platform. While developing the concept, we considered the challenges of the space environment, astronaut safety, ease of use, timely alerts, data accuracy, limited medical assistance during missions, and the importance of reliable communication with ground-based medical teams.

ASTROCARE – Healthy Astronauts. Safer Space Missions.
